H01.description: Adds regression tests for chunk hash changes with chunkImportMap preload deps and pure-CSS transitions.

H02.description: Adds SSR regression test for pure CSS dynamic chunks with chunkImportMap.

H04.description: Imports decodeURIIfPossible used by the D1 fix.

H05.description: Removes joinUrlSegments from ../utils import, paired with H03.

H06.description: decodeURI throws URIError on CSS urls containing a bare `%` (e.g. url(100%.png)), crashing CSS url resolution instead of keeping the url as is.

H07.description: Simplifies spread of possibly-undefined options; same behaviour.

H08.description: Type import needed by the D2 fix.

H09.description: Imports perEnvironmentState for the D2 fix.

H10.description: Adds helpers for import-map key signatures and preload dependency collection used by the D2 hash fix.

H11.description: Collects per-environment chunk graph in renderStart/renderChunk for the D2 augmentChunkHash fix.

H12.description: With chunkImportMap enabled, preload dependencies injected in generateBundle after hashing are not reflected in chunk hashes, so a chunk's content changes without its hash/filename changing (stale cache).

H13.description: Removed pure CSS chunks are left in the emitted import map, so it points to files that do not exist in the output.

H14.description: In the non-preload (e.g. SSR) path with chunkImportMap, the import specifier is an import-map key and is not mapped to the real filename, so dynamic imports of removed pure CSS chunks are not rewritten to Promise.resolve and fail at runtime.

H15.description: Removes getImportMap call that was moved earlier by the D3 fix.

H16.description: Changes const to let to allow reassignment in the refactor of H17.

H17.description: Replaces inline addDeps recursion with the shared collectPreloadDependencies helper; traversal order and pure-CSS rewrite behaviour appear unchanged.

I01.description: Test expectation update after a dependency bump; not a defect in head code.

I02.description: Environment sourcemap config handling in cssPostPlugin is unrelated to this change and not shown in head context.
